meta.source: BoardGameArena card sheets (trees.jpg, hCards.jpg, vCards.jpg, woodlands.jpg, mountain.jpg), base reference cards, rulebook PDFs; cross-checked against github.com/soldag/forest-shuffle-scoring
notes: Each half of a split card has its own tree_symbol; bonuses match on the symbol of the played card (either half for payment cards).
kinds=['TREE'] in filters means tree cards plus saplings; tree-species conditions exclude saplings; shrubs are neither trees nor mushrooms.
Set-scored species (Fireflies, Fire Salamander, Horse Chestnut) score the table value once for all copies, not per copy.
Butterflies score as sets of distinct species; a player can hold several sets and each card belongs to one set (greedy packing).
Costs verified from the card images. soldag/forest-shuffle-scoring lists Horse Chestnut 2, Crane Fly 2, Gentian 1, Wood Ant 0; the cards show 1, 1, 0, 1.

scoring.note: ties count as most; Violet Carpenter Bee adds to the count

modifiers.note: the tree it occupies counts as one additional tree of its species (Linden, Beech, Horse Chestnut sets; Moss and Woodpecker tree counts). Not for Sycamore/Red Deer per-tree counts.
